# Create final dataset

Load required libraries

```{r, load-libraries, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# library(dplyr)         # Data manipulation
# library(ggplot2)       # Data visualization
# library(kableExtra)    # Printing formatted tables
# library(PurpleAirAPI)  # Download PurpleAir Data
# library(leaflet)       # Interactive maps
# library(htmlwidgets)   # Creating HTML widgets
# library(webshot)       # Convert URL to image
# library(DataOverviewR) # Data dictionary and summary
library(data.table)    # Working with large files
library(lubridate)
```

```{r}
# Load datasets as data.tables

# purple air: sensor_index, time_stamp, rssi, uptime, memory, humidity, temperature, pressure, analog_input, pm2.5_alt, location_type, dow, hour, day, month, year, holiday, location_type_mode, pm2.5lag1, pm2.5lag3, pm2.5lag6, pm2.5lag12, pm2.5lag24
purpleair_data <- fread(file.path("data", "processed", "purpleair_data.csv"))

# wildfire: sensor_index, pa_date, fire_id, fire_distance, fire_direction, GIS_ACRES, fire_day, after_containment
wildfires_purpleair_dates <- fread(file.path("data", "processed", "wildfires_purpleair_dates.csv"))

# weather: station, timestamp, temp_fahrenheit, rel_humidity, wind_direction, wind_speed
weather_data <- fread(file.path("data", "raw", "weather.csv"))[, .(station, timestamp, temp_fahrenheit, rel_humidity, wind_direction, wind_speed)]

# weather stations: sensor_index, station, station_dist (scaled)
weather_pa <- fread(
  file.path("data", "processed", "weatherstations_pa.csv"))

# osm land: sensor_index, industrial, urban, artificial, natural, missing
land_data <- fread(file.path("data", "processed", "land_data.csv"))

# uber speeds: utc_timestamp, sensor_index, mean_congestion_major, mean_congestion_moderate, mean_congestion_minor, mean_speed_major, mean_speed_moderate, mean_speed_minor, n_measurements_major, n_measurements_moderate, n_measurements_minor
speeds_data <- fread(file.path("data", "processed", "speeds_data.csv"))
```

# scale weather station distance
```{}
weatherstpa <- read.csv(file.path("data", "processed", "weatherstations_purpleair.csv"))

# Scale `station_distance` to range [0, 1]
weatherstpa <- weatherstpa %>%
  mutate(station_dist = (station_distance - min(station_distance, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
           (max(station_distance, na.rm = TRUE) - min(station_distance, 
                                                      na.rm = TRUE))) %>% select(-station_distance)

write.csv(weatherstpa, file.path("data", "processed", "weatherstations_pa.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# date format
purpleair_data[, `:=`(
  date = as.Date(time_stamp)
)]

# purple air humidity and temp
setnames(purpleair_data, old = c("humidity", "temperature"), new = c("pa_humidity", "pa_temp"))

# convert year to binary
purpleair_data[, year := ifelse(year==2018,0,1)]

# summary(purpleair_data %>% select(-sensor_index, -time_stamp))
```


```{r}
wildfires_purpleair_dates <- wildfires_purpleair_dates %>% 
  mutate(
    f_sz = case_when(
      GIS_ACRES < 100 ~ 1,
      GIS_ACRES >= 100 & GIS_ACRES <= 1000 ~ 2,
      GIS_ACRES > 1000 ~ 3)
  )

wildfires_purpleair_dates[, pa_date := as.Date(pa_date)]

# summary(wildfires_purpleair_dates %>% select(-sensor_index, -pa_date, -fire_id))
```

```{r}
# Join weather station data
weather_stations <- merge(weather_data, weather_pa, 
                         by = "station", allow.cartesian = TRUE)

# summary(weather_stations %>% select(-station, -timestamp, -sensor_index))
```

```{r}
# Join all datasets
final_data <- purpleair_data[
  # Join land use data
  land_data, on = .(sensor_index)
][
  # Join traffic data
  speeds_data, on = .(sensor_index, time_stamp = utc_timestamp)
][
  # Join weather data
  weather_stations, on = .(sensor_index, time_stamp = timestamp)
][
  # Join wildfire data
  wildfires_purpleair_dates, on = .(sensor_index, date = pa_date)
]
```

```{r}
# remove rows with NA timestamp
final_data <- final_data[!is.na(time_stamp)]
# final_data[is.na(time_stamp)]
```

```{r}
# handle NA
traffic_cols <- c("mean_congestion_major", "mean_congestion_moderate", "mean_congestion_minor",
                 "mean_speed_major", "mean_speed_moderate", "mean_speed_minor")
final_data[, (traffic_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) fifelse(is.na(x), median(x, na.rm=TRUE), x)), 
          .SDcols = traffic_cols]

# Measurement counts should be 0 when NA
count_cols <- c("n_measurements_major", "n_measurements_moderate", "n_measurements_minor")
final_data[, (count_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) fifelse(is.na(x), 0, x)), 
          .SDcols = count_cols]

# Handle NAs in weather data
weather_cols <- c("temp_fahrenheit", "rel_humidity", "wind_direction", "wind_speed")
final_data[, (weather_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) fifelse(is.na(x), median(x, na.rm=TRUE), x)), 
          .SDcols = weather_cols]
```

```{r}
# scale land cols
scale_cols <- c("industrial", "urban", "artificial", "natural", "missing")
x_mean <- mean(unlist(final_data[, ..scale_cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
x_sd <- sd(unlist(final_data[, ..scale_cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
final_data[, (scale_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) (x - x_mean)/x_sd), 
           .SDcols = scale_cols]

# scale pm2.5 cols
scale_cols <- c("pm2.5_alt", "pm2.5lag1", "pm2.5lag3", "pm2.5lag6", "pm2.5lag12", "pm2.5lag24")
x_mean <- mean(unlist(final_data[, ..scale_cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
x_sd <- sd(unlist(final_data[, ..scale_cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
final_data[, (scale_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) (x - x_mean)/x_sd), 
           .SDcols = scale_cols]

# scale speed cols
scale_cols <- c("mean_speed_major", "mean_speed_moderate", "mean_speed_minor")
x_mean <- mean(unlist(final_data[, ..scale_cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
x_sd <- sd(unlist(final_data[, ..scale_cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
final_data[, (scale_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) (x - x_mean)/x_sd), 
           .SDcols = scale_cols]

# scale count cols
scale_cols <- c("n_measurements_major", "n_measurements_moderate", "n_measurements_minor")
x_mean <- mean(unlist(final_data[, ..scale_cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
x_sd <- sd(unlist(final_data[, ..scale_cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
final_data[, (scale_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) (x - x_mean)/x_sd), 
           .SDcols = scale_cols]

# scale temp cols
scale_cols <- c("pa_temp", "temp_fahrenheit")
x_mean <- mean(unlist(final_data[, ..scale_cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
x_sd <- sd(unlist(final_data[, ..scale_cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
final_data[, (scale_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) (x - x_mean)/x_sd), 
           .SDcols = scale_cols]
# scale humidity cols
scale_cols <- c("pa_humidity", "rel_humidity")
x_mean <- mean(unlist(final_data[, ..scale_cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
x_sd <- sd(unlist(final_data[, ..scale_cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
final_data[, (scale_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) (x - x_mean)/x_sd), 
           .SDcols = scale_cols]
```

```{r}
# fill fire nas
final_data[, `:=`(
  fire = as.numeric(!is.na(fire_id)),
  fire_distance = ifelse(is.na(fire_distance), max(fire_distance, na.rm=TRUE)*2, fire_distance),
  fire_direction = ifelse(is.na(fire_direction), 360*2, fire_direction),
  GIS_ACRES = ifelse(is.na(GIS_ACRES), 0, GIS_ACRES),
  fire_day = ifelse(is.na(fire_day), 0, fire_day),
  after_containment = as.numeric(replace_na(after_containment, 0))
)]

# Clean up and prepare final dataset
final_data <- final_data[, `:=`(
  wind_direction = scale(wind_direction),
  wind_speed = scale(wind_speed),
  fire_distance = scale(fire_distance),
  fire_direction = scale(fire_direction),
  fire_day = scale(fire_day),
  rssi = scale(rssi),
  uptime = scale(uptime),
  memory = scale(memory),
  pressure = scale(pressure),
  GIS_ACRES = scale(GIS_ACRES)
)]
```


```{r}
# drop columns
final_data[, c("date", "station", "fire_id") := NULL]
```

```{r}
# Check for remaining NAs
na_summary <- final_data[, lapply(.SD, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))]
print(na_summary)
```

```{r}
fwrite(final_data, file.path("data", "processed", "final_dataset.csv"))
```

```{r}
# Add engineered features
dataset[, `:=`(
  # Time features
  is_rush_hour = as.numeric(hour %in% c(7,8,9,16,17,18)),
  is_weekend = as.numeric(dow %in% c(1,7)),
  season = fcase(
    month %in% c(12,1,2), 1,
    month %in% c(3,4,5), 2,
    month %in% c(6,7,8), 3,
    month %in% c(9,10,11), 4
  ),
  
  # Weather interactions
  temp_humid = pa_temp * pa_humidity,
  wind_speed_direction = wind_speed * cos(wind_direction),
  
  # Traffic-time interactions
  rush_congestion = mean_congestion_major * (hour %in% c(7,8,9,16,17,18)),
  
  # Fire-weather interactions
  fire_wind = ifelse(fire == 1, 
                    wind_speed * cos((wind_direction - fire_direction) * pi/180), 
                    0)
)]

# Sort and split data
dataset <- dataset[order(time_stamp)]
split_index <- floor(0.7 * nrow(dataset))
split_time <- dataset$time_stamp[split_index]
# Create training and test sets
train_data <- dataset[time_stamp <= split_time]
test_data <- dataset[time_stamp > split_time]
```

```{r}
)]

summary(train_data$pm2.5_alt)

```

Outliers
```{}
final_data <- final_data[
  temperature < 150 &  # Remove impossible temperature values
  pressure < 1100 &    # Remove extreme pressure values
  memory < 60000 &     # Remove outlier memory values
  pm2.5_alt < 500      # Remove extreme PM2.5 values
]
```

Cleaning
```{}
final_data <- final_data[, `:=`(
  # Clean wind direction - circular variable
  wind_direction_sin = sin(2 * pi * wind_direction/360),
  wind_direction_cos = cos(2 * pi * wind_direction/360),
  
  # Create time features
  is_rush_hour = hour %in% c(7,8,9,16,17,18),
  is_weekend = dow %in% c(1,7),
  season = fcase(
    month %in% c(12,1,2), "winter",
    month %in% c(3,4,5), "spring",
    month %in% c(6,7,8), "summer",
    month %in% c(9,10,11), "fall"
  ),
  
  # Standardize land use proportions
  land_total = industrial + urban + artificial + natural + missing,
  industrial_pct = industrial/land_total,
  urban_pct = urban/land_total,
  artificial_pct = artificial/land_total,
  natural_pct = natural/land_total,
  missing_pct = missing/land_total
)]
```

Interaction terms
```{}
final_data <- final_data[, `:=`(
  # Weather interactions
  temp_humid = temperature_scaled * humidity_scaled,
  wind_temp = wind_speed * temperature_scaled,
  
  # Traffic-time interactions
  congestion_rush = mean_congestion_major_scaled * is_rush_hour,
  
  # Environmental-traffic interactions
  speed_temp = mean_speed_major_scaled * temperature_scaled,
  
  # Fire-weather interactions
  fire_wind = ifelse(fire_distance > 0, 
                    wind_speed * cos((wind_direction - fire_direction) * pi/180), 
                    0),
                    
  # Urban-traffic interactions
  urban_congestion = urban_pct * mean_congestion_major_scaled,
  
  # Weighted congestion by road type presence
  congestion_weighted = (n_measurements_major * mean_congestion_major_scaled +
                        n_measurements_moderate * mean_congestion_moderate_scaled +
                        n_measurements_minor * mean_congestion_minor_scaled) /
                       (n_measurements_major + n_measurements_moderate + n_measurements_minor)
)]
```
